source.session_policy: require an explicit true acquisition-session field; never infer it from part, class block, source index, or position

split.unit: image category label_index; every image and its cross-subject records remain in the category split

features.pair_transform: absolute difference of corresponding electrode-frequency powers
features.position_encoding: fixed feature columns preserve electrode and frequency identity; no subject, session, source index, class-block position, or absolute recording position enters model inputs

T1_same_person.positive: two different images from one subject, same category
T1_same_person.negative: the same matched two image IDs and category, split across two different subjects
T1_same_person.matching: each positive and negative pair shares exactly the same unordered image pair and category

T2_same_person_same_true_session.positive: same subject and same explicitly recorded acquisition session
T2_same_person_same_true_session.negative: same subject and different explicitly recorded acquisition sessions
T2_same_person_same_true_session.status: unavailable until true session labels and trial mapping are present

T3_adjacent_within_person_category.positive: same subject and category, source-position gap 1
T3_adjacent_within_person_category.negative: same subject and category, source-position gap 7, matched midpoint
T3_adjacent_within_person_category.time_source: class-block source order proxy; no independent timestamp available

svm.kernel_implementation: BLAS-computed precomputed Gram matrices; verify against sklearn RBF decision_function
svm.standardization: fit separately on the model's training pairs; final model refits preprocessing on train plus validation

selection.test_use: one final evaluation after model selection and train-plus-validation refit

models.pca: not enabled in the first run; any later PCA must be fit only on the relevant training pair set
